summary: Narrow lane serving private driveways, steep and walled by trees and homes.
reasons: Narrow lane, no room to pull off

drivers.seclusion: Bush on the west side, but houses sit 13-18 m away at 33, 44 and 71 m and the lane ends at their driveways.
drivers.access_and_room: Single-width lane with no verge, edged by trees and fences; a van would block residents' driveways.
drivers.traffic: Very little traffic, but it is a dead-end access lane to homes.
drivers.convention: A few cars sit in driveways near 0 and 50 m; none parked along the kerb.

flags: Steep beyond 55 m: 8.7% mean, 22% max grade
Low ground at the far end, about 8 m elevation, 152 m from Brisbane River
Gate 243 m away has a mapped way round
sun_shade: Dense canopy over the lane; shaded most of the day.
cannot_judge: Whether the lane is public or private

best_section.where: West side of the lane north of the Jilba Street junction
